selection.background_policy: inactive model IDs; first original anchor; 12x8x6 spatial grid, seeded cell order and within-cell order, round-robin depth; display subset, not a density estimate

geometry: all source skeleton vertices and edges retained; no imputed branches, smoothing, graph layout, branch pruning, or artificial connecting edges

projection.units: micrometres; original nanometres divided by 1000; orthographic rigid rotation

encoding: neuron-group membership; colours do not show observed activity travelling along neurites
context_warning: JFRC2 registered neuropil atlas, not the specimen EM surface; 512 context neurons are a spatial display sample, not an anatomical-density estimate
terms: Retain FlyWire public-data attribution and terms https://flywire.ai/guidelines . The Schlegel supplemental Zenodo skeleton archive is CC BY 4.0; this per-root Cambridge mirror has no license field in info.json, and byte identity to the archive has not been tested. No first-party relicensing.

figure.sources_rasterized: neurite and atlas geometry only; all labels remain editable
